newsitem.title: FRANCE: Kohl says dollar to find level against euro.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says dollar to find level against euro.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl told French television he believed the dollar would find its level according to the euro.

"In my view, the dollar will find its level according to the euro. At the moment we are in a transitional phase. There are people in Europe, also in Germany, who say 'No one knows whether the euro will come about, and whether it will be a good currency'. We must not imagine that we have the last word on this," he told TF1 television in an interview.
A transcript of the interview, scheduled to be aired at 1800 GMT on Sunday, was sent to Reuters.

"International capital flows follow quite different laws. And the law of capital flows will be, I can tell you now, that once it is quite clear that the euro is going to happen, once it is quite clear that the euro is a stable currency, then they'll move in that direction. They don't ask chancellors or presidents of the Republic for instructions," Kohl said.
